reviewSamples.author: David Levick
reviewSamples.text: Lando was fantastic! He answered the phone immediately and even agreed to do a FaceTime call so he could assess the issue and provide an estimate before coming out. He arrived promptly, charged a fair and reasonable price, and completed the job quickly and professionally. I really appreciated his honesty, responsiveness, and quality of work. I highly recommend Lando to anyone looking for a reliable mechanic!

reviewSamples.author: Gabriel Escalante
reviewSamples.text: Amazing service and expertise. Always answers the phone and communicates well. Had a bad power steering pump and he had it fixed before I was done with work. I had bad motor mounts and a belt tensioner snap on me so I left it with him after work. I had the car back and better than ever in under 24 hrs and was able to get to work the next day. 100% worth every $. Highly recommend to anyone who needs reliable & quality service.

reviewSamples.author: Alison McDonald
reviewSamples.text: Lando is an angel! I could not afford to go to Mercedes Benz, went to Auto Zone and they were clueless. Lando realized in 1 minute that it was my belt. I purchased belt and paid him for his service which was very reasonable. He is polite, respectful, TRUST WORTHY and a great person. Most of all VERY TALENTED. My car is 100% back to itself. I am truly grateful! I honestly don't know what I would have done without him. Thank you Lando! GOD BLESS YOU

reviewSamples.author: Mark Herrera
reviewSamples.text: I was recommended Lando by a coworker. Hes so good! Hes the Mechanic you think about when you want a personal Mechanic. Reliable, quick, friendly, honest. Hes definitely for the people. He'll go the extra mile for you. This the one. Look no further.

reviewSamples.author: Rachel Rafael
reviewSamples.text: He fixed my serpentine belt that another mechanic couldn't do in less than 30 minutes I highly highly recommend him he's the best and super nice. He told me a few things I might have to replace soon and that Amazon had them for the best prices. He's the best truly
